title: Companion disapproval is inconsistently telegraphed. Killing the starving 'gaunt wolf' produced 'Lys disapproves' only after the strike landed, with zero warning. The very next wolf (the ash wolf at Twin Stones) got an explicit pre-combat warning from Lys ('Leave it... we can go around') before I could act. Same category of choice, opposite signaling.
where: Wolf Scrape / attack gaunt wolf with plain sword
